question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: When to reply? Context Sensitive Models to Predict Instructor Interventions in MOOC Forums
answer_rationale: The evidence indicates that the models are evaluated on a corpus of 12 MOOC iterations on Coursera.org, which includes data from various courses and instructors, implying multilingual or non-English data is not exclusively used. The data is described as diverse and representative of MOOCs of varying sizes and instructor styles, without any indication that only English data is used.
